signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

legacy_composite_full_skin.comparison_scope: Exact historical SC2 amplitude; current/power equality on SC4 is not asserted

raw_1Vpp.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
raw_1Vpp.source_Vpp_definition: actual max-minus-min of commanded nonzero-tone source spectrum before50ohm; bounds, not each tone Vpp

signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

equal_total_power.comparison_scope: Exact historical SC2 amplitude; current/power equality on SC4 is not asserted

skin_contact_only.interpretation: Historical SC2 mode amplitude reused exactly; its current/power/burden equality is not asserted on SC4

signed_per_output_power_evidence.signed_power_scope: Metal delivered power includes passive-output absorption; no negative value clamped
signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

raw_1Vpp.comparison_scope: Supplemental SC4 rematch using unchanged original SC2 caps/current/power/cutoffs

equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.source_Vpp_definition: actual max-minus-min of commanded nonzero-tone source spectrum before50ohm; bounds, not each tone Vpp
equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.normalization_reference: ORIGINAL SC2 square constants only; no SC4 baseline caps

equal_total_source_output_RMS_sum.interpretation: Historical SC2 mode amplitude reused exactly; its current/power/burden equality is not asserted on SC4

signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

signed_per_output_power_evidence.signed_power_scope: Metal delivered power includes passive-output absorption; no negative value clamped
signed_per_output_power_evidence.current_scope: Each physical source output RMS over distinct frequencies; not common-GND return current

skin_contact_only.comparison_scope: Supplemental SC4 rematch using unchanged original SC2 caps/current/power/cutoffs

legacy_composite_full_skin.interpretation: numerical normalization only; baseline limits are not human safety limits
legacy_composite_full_skin.source_Vpp_definition: actual max-minus-min of commanded nonzero-tone source spectrum before50ohm; bounds, not each tone Vpp
legacy_composite_full_skin.normalization_reference: ORIGINAL SC2 square constants only; no SC4 baseline caps
